findings.body: This added failed-Join retry case, together with the following different-invite case, changes the plan for Done-when 5. That item is context only for this part, and the plan file is outside the permitted paths. The API list-and-add work does not need these T4D test-plan edits.

findings.title: Later: T1D, T4E and T4B — complete edit rules and screen refusals
